ownership.integrationPolicy: Base owners remain unchanged. This owner re-executes FloorDrain100 and adds a reversible routed-hose/floor refinement.

manufactureInstallation.floor: Sloped cementitious balcony floor with 4 mm waterproof skin, preserving the rainwater penetration and adding a real circular floor-drain well cutout.
manufactureInstallation.floorDrain: Existing-owner BalconyFloorDrain100 re-executed with 18 real grate slots, EPDM bedding ring, PVC flange/well/outlet and center screw; grate top translated flush to finished floor.
manufactureInstallation.condensateRoute: Existing corrugated condensate-hose concept refined into a continuous hollow gravity-fall route from the measured service-side start center to 18 mm above the drain center.
manufactureInstallation.interfaces: Hose start matches prior owner center; 43.4 mm floor cutout clears the 43 mm drain well while retaining 8.6 mm radial flange bearing beneath the 52 mm flange.
manufactureInstallation.weathering: Only a thin mineral/silt trace is authored on the low/outward side of the drain, following the 1.5% floor fall. No random grime, algae, rust or painted shadow.
manufactureInstallation.orientationExposure: Y up; exterior +Z; floor falls 1.5% to +Z. Lighting is unbaked and remains a Unity responsibility.
manufactureInstallation.geometryVsMaterial: Floor/drain openings, mortar/coating solids, grate apertures, flange/well/outlet, hollow corrugated hose and outlet sleeve are geometry; microstructure is PBR texture proxy.

DrainHosePVC.uvAging: exterior chalking reserved for later causal mask
